data.gender_notes: Bablu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hindi word ‘baba’, meaning ‘father’, Bablu is a diminutive form used to refer to a little boy or a dear one. The name Bablu carries the meaning “Little One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bablu usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Bablu belongs to the Hindi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bablu total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

Bablu was a high-ranking servant in the Mughal emperor Akbar's court during the late 16th century. He was known for his exceptional intelligence and was appointed as the chief librarian and accountant of the imperial library and treasury.
